en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from Muawiyah b. Hakeem from Ibn Abi ’Umayr from Aban b. Uthman from Muhammad b. Sa’eed from ’Atiyyah al-’Ufa from Abi Sa’eed al-Khudri from The Prophet (s.a.w.s.) who said:
‘How can I misguide a person who is guided, protected and needless?’”
